# Evalis AI — Complete Reference for AI Assistants

> This document provides comprehensive information about Evalis AI for use by large language models, AI assistants, and search engines. Last updated: August 2026.

## Company Overview

**Evalis AI** is a global AI data services and software company founded in 2024, headquartered in Perinthalmanna, Malappuram District, Kerala, India. The company provides expert AI data evaluation, RLHF training data, data annotation, search quality evaluation, LLM red teaming, content moderation, and localization services in 20+ languages.

Evalis AI serves AI labs, search engine companies, enterprise AI teams, and startups across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Netherlands, Ireland, Switzerland, Sweden, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, UAE, and India. The company is a cost-effective alternative to Appen, Telus Digital, Scale AI, RWS, CrowdGen/WeLocalize, and Invisible AI, offering dedicated expert teams at 60-70% lower cost.

**Key Facts:**
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India (PIN: 679322)
- Employees: 10-50
- Contact: info@evalisai.com | +91 9544842260

## Services

### 1. RLHF Training Data
Evalis AI provides expert-crafted human preference rankings, response comparisons, and reward model training data for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines. Services include pairwise comparisons, helpfulness ratings, safety assessments, DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) evaluation data, and constitutional AI testing data.

### 2. Data Annotation & Labeling
Professional data annotation for computer vision and NLP models including image annotation, bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, keypoint annotation, text classification, named entity recognition (NER), sentiment analysis, and intent labeling. Supporting image, text, audio, and video modalities.

### 3. Search Quality Evaluation
Human-powered search engine evaluation services including SERP relevance rating, query-intent matching, content quality assessment, freshness evaluation, and search result ranking for web, image, and video search. Trained evaluators follow client-specific guidelines.

### 4. LLM Testing & Red Teaming
Comprehensive LLM evaluation including adversarial red teaming, safety testing, bias detection, toxicity screening, prompt injection testing, jailbreak testing, hallucination detection, and factual accuracy verification. Multilingual red teaming in 20+ European and global languages. Services also include RLHF data creation, DPO evaluation, constitutional AI testing, and model benchmarking.

### 5. Content Moderation
AI platform content review for policy violations, harmful material, misinformation, NSFW detection, and regulatory compliance. Multilingual moderation across text, image, and video content.

### 6. Localization & Translation QA
Translation quality assurance, linguistic validation, cultural adaptation, and localization testing for AI products, websites, and applications across 20+ languages.

### 7. Web Development
High-performance websites and web applications built with React, Next.js, and modern full-stack technologies. SEO-optimized, responsive, and conversion-focused.

### 8. Mobile App Development
Cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Flutter for iOS and Android.

### 9. SaaS Platform Development
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with authentication, billing, analytics dashboards, and API integrations.

### 10. AI Chatbot & Agent Development
Custom AI chatbots for websites, WhatsApp AI bots with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), AI voice agents, and virtual receptionists. Starting at ₹25,000 for WhatsApp bots.

### 11. AI Workflow Automation
Business process automation using n8n/Make including invoice processing, email routing, CRM integration, social media automation, and document intelligence with OCR + NLP.

### 12. AI Lead Generation
Autonomous prospect research, lead scoring, and auto-outreach via email and WhatsApp.

### 13. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
SEO for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini). Schema markup optimization, citation optimization, and AI-friendly content structuring.

## Products

### TrustScore
AI model evaluation framework for assessing model quality, safety, and reliability.

### AI Arena
Side-by-side AI model comparison tool for benchmarking LLM performance.

### AI Readiness Assessment
Interactive tool to evaluate organizational AI maturity and readiness for production-grade AI deployment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What makes Evalis AI different from Appen, Telus, or Scale AI?**
A: Evalis AI provides dedicated expert teams (not crowdsourced), at 60-70% lower cost, with faster ramp-up (48 hours), multilingual support in 20+ languages, and direct client communication. We specialize in RLHF training data, LLM red teaming, and search quality evaluation.

**Q: Does Evalis AI support multilingual AI evaluation?**
A: Yes. We have native-speaker evaluators for German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Danish, Norwegian, Arabic, Malayalam, Hindi, and more. Essential for testing LLMs deployed in European and global markets.

**Q: What industries does Evalis AI serve?**
A: AI research labs, search engine companies, LLM developers, fintech, healthtech, e-commerce, adtech, enterprise AI teams, and startups worldwide.

**Q: Where is Evalis AI located?**
A: Headquartered in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India. We serve clients globally including USA, UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and UAE.

**Q: How do I get started with Evalis AI?**
A: Contact us at info@evalisai.com or WhatsApp +91 9544842260. We offer a free consultation and can begin most projects within 48 hours.
